name: Registry

test_list.description: A session written with upsert_session is returned unchanged by get_session (all fields, including the optional sandbox checkpoint).
get_session of an id that was never written is Ok(None), not an error.
Upserting the same metadata twice leaves one row; a later upsert never rewrites the stored created_at.
A second upsert replaces name, branch, token counters, checkpoint and status of the existing row.
list_sessions returns the newest updated_at first (/sessions ordering).
SessionFilter narrows by status, by workspace and caps the row count.
archive sets Archived and unarchive sets Active, both bump updated_at; an unknown id reports false.
A counter above i64::MAX cannot be stored in SQLite and is refused with BadValue instead of wrapping.
proptest: any metadata (arbitrary text and counters) reads back identical.

inputs.name: meta
inputs.description: Session catalogue row to insert or update (keyed by SessionId).

output_description: Durable, idempotent session catalogue rows in registry.db.
